_readme: Only the banners listed here are overridden -- every other banner keeps
its real master.mdb pool, odds and guarantees. Delete or rename this file
to put 30111 back on real odds too. Format doc: gacha_banners.json.example
30111 (support banner) is pinned to a single card: 30016, an SSR (rarity 3)
support card, at the whole pool's weight. Every slot of a single or a
ten-pull on this banner draws 30016; the ten-pull's guaranteed
2-star-or-better slot is satisfied by it as well, and dupes convert to
goddess statues / exchange points exactly as they normally would.
